description: Reads every directory listing waiting for this business, best fit first, in one read: the listing kit (every value to fill a form with, and what is not on file), and for each place its address, how it is sent (form, pull request, issue, email), whether it needs an account or money, its own rules, whether Marsell could tell if the business is already there, where an earlier try stopped, and for package managers the manifest files written for the pull request. Also `brief`: the same as one text an agent with a browser can work from, and the places Marsell sends itself once the owner says yes on its card. Reads only.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: listings_read
title: Listings read
